description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 7 June 2024 with many Pokémon from the game's Hidden Treasure of Area Zero story. The mythical Pecharunt ex leads it in Pecharunt's first card, with the three Pokémon it commands, Okidogi ex, Munkidori ex and Fezandipiti ex: Pecharunt ex's Ability switches its player's Active Pokémon with a Benched Darkness Pokémon and Poisons the new one, and Okidogi ex's attack does 260 damage while it is Poisoned. Kingdra ex and Revavroom ex join them, with the ACE SPEC cards Dangerous Laser, which Burns and Confuses the opponent's Active Pokémon, Poké-Vital A and Neutralization Zone, the Supporters Colress's Tenacity, Janine's Secret Art and Cassiopeia, and Night Stretcher. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 64, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Pecharunt ex, Earthen Vessel and Powerglass. In English most of its cards came out in Shrouded Fable in August 2024.
